author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: Save made by birdybro on MiSTer on 2022-03-03 to show the file size with an NES 2.0-headered ROM ('forced a save, and it created 8KB files').
note: MiSTer NES core (2022 build), ROM with an NES 2.0 header that declares 8 KiB of battery PRG-RAM, so the core wrote exactly 8 KiB. Zip held this and the Proving Grounds save.
